findings.message: This `new Promise` around a `setTimeout` is a hand-rolled `delay`. Write `await delay(milliseconds);` with `import { delay } from '@nexus/source/coordination/Delay';`. The promise does nothing but resolve after a timer, which is exactly what `delay` does, and spelling it out at every call site makes the reader check each one for the variant it might be (a value passed to `resolve`, a timer kept for cancelling, a reject path) before they can read past it. One named wait says it is a plain wait.
